name: Bleeding in Ink
summary:
Your library science major has taught you a few things—first, that the world is cruel and believes your kind would be better off serving up iced lattes and scones. Second, researching yourself is king and AI scrubs are the devil. And third... never write in a library book.

Unfortunately, it seems you weren't a very good student, as you find yourself breaking that final rule during your first job in the field. What you thought to be a nice little distraction amongst the onslaught of purging outdated nonfiction and superseded encyclopedias quickly turns into an obsession—because when you write in the book's pages, the book writes back, and he's been long overdue for a penpal.
